h1: Is Psalm 23 a Good Choice for Sleep Meditation?
meta_description: Find peace at bedtime with the words of Psalm 23. Explore a nightly practice of listening to scripture in a quiet, simple, and ad-free environment.
direct_answer: Psalm 23 is a nightly practice of reflecting on the shepherd’s care. It offers a steady rhythm for the end of your day. By listening to the words of David, you turn your thoughts toward the quiet pastures and still waters mentioned in the text, grounding your heart in scripture before you rest.

sections.heading: Why choose the Psalms for your evening rest?
paragraphs: The Psalms have served as a companion for the weary for generations. When the house grows quiet and the day’s work is done, many find comfort in the familiar cadence of these ancient songs. Psalm 23, in particular, provides a steady focus. It reminds the reader that they are not alone. It speaks of a shepherd who leads, restores, and provides. This is not about a quick fix or a change in mindset. It is simply a way to fill your mind with the word of God as you settle into your bed.

Our app offers a space for this nightly practice. You can listen to whispered readings that keep the tone gentle and unhurried. There are no sudden noises or distracting advertisements here. You are free to focus on the text itself. Whether you choose to read the King James Version or listen to the Reina-Valera 1909 in Mi Refugio, the goal remains the same: to keep the word of God near you until you drift off.

sections.heading: How does the Bible chat feature work?
paragraphs: Sometimes you may have questions about a verse you just read. Our Bible chat is an AI tool designed to help you explore the scriptures. It is clearly labeled as AI so you always know how it functions. It does not offer personal advice or opinions. Instead, it quotes the King James Version word for word to answer your questions. If you ask about a specific theme in Psalm 23, the chat will provide the relevant verses directly from the text. This keeps the focus on the Bible itself. It is a simple, plain way to deepen your understanding while you prepare for the night. You can also use this feature during your morning time to start your day with a clear focus on the truth of the scriptures.

sections.heading: What is the experience of using Peace Be Still?
paragraphs: We believe that your time with the Bible should be free from interruptions. You will find no ads on our pages. We offer a free lane that is available to everyone, forever. If you choose to support our work, there is a paid lane. This ensures that the app remains a quiet place for your daily practice. We are building a space that feels like a grandmother's front porch after dark. It is unhurried, plain, and warm. You will find that the app is designed to be a companion for your morning and evening routines. It is a place where you can return day after day to find the scriptures waiting for you. We are working hard to bring this experience to your phone soon. Look for Peace Be Still in the App Store and Google Play.

sections.heading: Finding rest in the shadow of the Almighty
paragraphs: Beyond Psalm 23, many find solace in other parts of the book of Psalms. We have created a specific resource called Psalm 91 Prayer for Sleep: Rest in the Shadow of the Almighty. This page explores how the promises of protection and presence found in Psalm 91 can shape your evening thoughts. Just like Psalm 23, these verses are meant to be a steady anchor for your soul. By focusing on the word of God, you create a boundary between the busyness of the day and the rest of the night. We invite you to explore these readings as part of your regular habits. Whether you are seeking a moment of quiet in the morning or a gentle transition at night, the scriptures are always there to guide you.

faq.q: Can I use this app for my morning routine?
faq.a: Yes. You can use the app to read the King James Bible or listen to daily prayers and declarations. It is designed to help you start your day with the word of God, providing a steady and quiet foundation before your daily tasks begin.

faq.q: Is there a trial period for the paid features?
faq.a: No, there is no trial period. We offer a free lane that is available forever. If you choose to access the full range of features, the paid lane is available for a monthly or yearly subscription without any surprise charges or hidden fees.

faq.q: Are the Bible stories suitable for my family?
faq.a: Yes. We include Bible stories told in a Black church voice in Hush Harbor. These are designed to be shared with your family, offering a way to engage with the scriptures that is both meaningful and visually representative for many households.

faq.q: How do I get the app on my phone?
faq.a: The app is coming soon to the App Store and Google Play. We are working to ensure it is ready for you to download. Please check back for updates on when you can find Peace Be Still on your preferred mobile device.
